description.value:
You gain one of the following Channel the Force options: Snap Aggression if you chose Juyo, or Assertive Defense if you chose Vaapad.

Snap Aggression. If you're surprised at the start of combat but aren't incapacitated, you may spend a use of Channel the Force to act normally on your first turn anyway.

Assertive Defense. When you use the saber reflect power to reduce a force power's damage to 0 while wielding a lightweapon or vibroweapon you're proficient with, you may spend a use of Channel the Force to redirect that attack at a target within its range, regardless of the damage type involved.
